name: runkey-persistence-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): plants HKLM Run-key persistence. Writes a PowerShell payload file ($PAYLOAD_PATH/$PAYLOAD_BODY) and a Run value ($RUN_VALUE_NAME) under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run that launches it hidden at any user logon. Vars: RUN_VALUE_NAME (required); PAYLOAD_PATH (required); PAYLOAD_BODY (optional); ARGUMENTS (optional extra args). Idempotent.
